author: Ubisoft
description:
Echoes of Central Park launches November 3, 2026.
Pre-order now and unlock the Central Park-inspired mask at launch.
 
Tom Clancy's The Division® 2: Echoes of Central Park invites agents to explore New York's iconic landmark for the first time in the franchise's history.
 
When the Division intercepts a mysterious distress signal deep within the park, agents are deployed to extract a high-value target. What begins as a rescue mission soon becomes a journey through a place overtaken by fear, mystery, and a new apex threat lurking in the shadows.
 
Echoes of Central Park is a narrative-driven expansion set after Warlords of New York. Play solo or in co-op as you explore Central Park and the Upper West Side, fight alongside unique companions, earn powerful new gear including a brand-new Exotic Weapon, unlock new skill variants, and uncover the truth behind the mystery consuming New York's iconic landmark. author: Ubisoft
description:
The Crew Motorfest Year 4 kicks off on October 7th, bringing a full year of new content, features and experiences to the islands.
Starting with Season 11, head to Kaua'i, discover new wildlife, master the winch and join forces with Lara Croft in an all-new Tomb Raider Playlist, included in the Year 4 Pass or in the DLC Pack.
In January, Season 12 brings the Yangwang U9 Xtreme to Motorfest, before Season 13 introduces semi-trucks to The Crew for the first time in April.
And throughout the year, look forward to new TrackForge features, PvP, quality-of-life improvements and more.
Watch the Year 4 Deep Dive to discover what’s coming to Motorfest.

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges.
